window.bar.appear.about: The input bars' own entrance, up from below with a small swing as they land. At 0 milliseconds they have none and arrive with their window; given a time, they come up on their own instead.

window.sub.open.about: A sub-window opening where it stands, rising its last pixels into place, and fading out there as it closes.

window.tab.move.about: A tab gliding to its place and width in the row.

window.tab.controls.about: A tab's own controls going and coming as the row narrows and widens: the room glides in one half, the ink fades in the other.

window.tab.lift.about: A carried tab rising its pixel off the row, and settling back once it is put down.

window.tab.glow.about: The glow a tab put down gives once in its colour, on its own surface and the tool strip's, fading out in this many milliseconds.

window.tab.marquee.about: A name cut short read whole under a resting pointer: after this many milliseconds it slides speed pixels a second until its end shows, rests pause milliseconds there, slides back, and rests again.

window.snap.assist.about: The snap assist's panes coming and going.

window.snap.layouts.about: The snap layouts' flyout coming and going, the snap bar fading in and out, and the bar coming all the way down from its peek once the pointer touches it, and back.

window.snap.preview.about: The frosted preview of where a window will snap, growing out of the window and fading.

window.snap.bar.peek.about: The snap bar peeking further down from the top of the screen as a carried window's pointer comes nearer it, and back up: most of the way in this many seconds.

window.search.clear.about: The search well's magnifier crossing over to its cross while a search stands in it.

window.fill.about: A window gliding to the part of the screen it fills, and back.

window.icon.flip.about: A chevron control playing its run of frames between open and closed.

window.scroll.about: A history, list or panel gliding to where it was scrolled: most of the way in this many seconds.

window.hover.fade.about: A row or control crossing to its lit shade and back.

window.stack.fade.about: A window or a sub-window fading an eighth for each window that comes to lie over it, down to half, and back as they go: most of the way in this many seconds.

window.marquee.return.about: A name cut short gliding home once the pointer leaves it.

window.notice.about: A short notice over a window's bar, why a page closed by itself or that a locked window cannot be changed: fading in as it rises its last pixels, standing hold milliseconds while it is read, then fading out where it stands.

window.answer.about: A page's answer over its bar, saved or refused: fading in as it rises its last pixels, standing hold milliseconds while it is read, then fading out where it stands. One that waits for the server stands until the answer comes.

window.view.line.about: Leave Full Window (Esc), at the top of a window its page fills: fading in, standing hold milliseconds as the page comes to fill it and while the pointer is near the top, then fading out where it stands.

window.bar.grow.about: An input bar growing a row taller as the words typed in it wrap onto another row, and shrinking back: most of the way in this many seconds.
